title: OUTCLAW
description:
Список возможностей

Об игреStep into the paws of Comet, a strange, five-eyed cat lost in a strange world. Collect and command chaotic feline shades that morph into ramps, bombs, and more to help you on your journey. Fight enemies, explore mystic worlds, and build your hub in a colorful third-person adventure.

CUTE AND CHAOTIC HORDEGather and collect lost shades to join your family. On adventures, you can transform shades into a variety of objects and shapes to help you solve puzzles and problems. Over time, the shades will become part of a strange, found family as you seek a home among the stars.

A GALAXY OF GOODIESA galaxy of collectible goodies await - your curiosity will be rewarded with keychains, unlockable customisation options for your hub and even snazzy little accessories for your minions.

EXPLORE A GORGEOUS GALAXYThere are 12 unique levels with their own unique enemies and giant bosses to defeat! A starry and surreal universe is waiting for you to discover its secrets. 

ABOUT USHey there! We’re Moss Monkey, a UK-based team formed from a shared passion for making games with immersive worlds to explore, strong aesthetics and adorable characters.
description_short: Collect and command a horde of mischievous shapeshifting minions as you explore this starry world. Turn chaos into connection in this surreal puzzle action-adventure about carving out your own strange little family.
